paper: Maximal Simplification of Polyhedral Reductions (POPL 2025), successor to arXiv:2411.17498v1
selection: All seven .alpha files in upstream inputs/, plus three separately labelled controls. No selection by measured result.
developmentExposure: Original prefix_sum compiler smoke was run before freeze. All sources are public. This is not a holdout or independent external evaluation.
sharedFragment: Ordered prefix sums of an integer polynomial over one or more strictly increasing row indices, with X and Y each declared on 0..N. max, non-prefix domains, multiple output indices and variable denominators remain explicit unsupported cases.
